name: Wake Slider
description: A slider built from slim bars; dragging sends a wave of height through them that traces the path of movement.
interactionNotes: Drag or click on the track; the bars next to the handle rise like a wave, and the faster you drag the taller they get. The handle lags behind the movement and then settles, so it has a sense of weight. The arrow keys work too and mirror in right-to-left.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Leave it out to keep it internal.

props.name: bars
props.description: Number of bars; more means a smoother wave and heavier rendering.

props.name: height
props.description: Full height of the bars, in pixels.

props.name: crestColor
props.description: Color of the wave crest layer; empty means the same as the fill color.

props.name: reach
props.description: The maximum distance the wave reaches from the handle.

props.name: skew
props.description: Asymmetry of the wave: behind is taller than ahead.

props.name: glide
props.description: Glide of the handle toward the target; low means lazier.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value number next to the track.

tips: Want a tall wave? Raise `reach` and `sensitivity` together — either one alone has little effect.
For a "heavier" feel, bring `glide` down; for "fast and nimble", raise it.
On mobile, 32 bars render together; if something gets slow, reduce `bars`.
